landing_hero_title: Play Minecraft with your friends tonight
landing_hero_sub: Your own server, ready in about a minute. No tech skills needed - if you can order a pizza, you can run this.
landing_address_hint: Your server gets a real address like
landing_steps_title: Three steps. That's the whole tutorial.
landing_steps_sub: No guides, no videos, no forum posts. This is genuinely all of it.
landing_step1_desc: This becomes your server address. Type it in Minecraft and you're in - that's how addresses work here.
landing_step2_desc: Survival, Creative, Hardcore or Superflat. Tap a picture. Done.
landing_step3_desc: They type it into Minecraft and join. No ports, no IPs, no "it's not working".
landing_notech_title: Everything you never wanted to learn
landing_notech_sub: Other hosts expect you to know this stuff. We just handle it.
landing_f1_desc: Add your friends by their Minecraft name - you even see their skin. Only they can join. Strangers stay out.
landing_f2_title: It sleeps when you don't play
landing_f2_desc: Nobody online? Your server goes to sleep and stops eating resources. A friend joins? It wakes up by itself.
landing_f3_desc: Download the full world anytime with one click. Cancel anytime - your creations leave with you.
landing_f4_desc: Difficulty, game mode, PvP - clear switches with plain words. Change something, hit apply, keep playing.
landing_pricing_sub: Everything included. No tiers, no upsells, no "premium features".
landing_faq1_q: Do I need to know anything about servers?
landing_faq1_a: No. Literally nothing. If you can pick a name and click a picture, you have all the skills required.
landing_faq2_a: You send them your address, like coolkids.hosting-mc.com. They open Minecraft, add server, paste it. That's all.
landing_faq3_q: What happens when nobody is playing?
landing_faq3_a: Your server goes to sleep automatically. The moment anyone tries to join, it wakes up. You never touch anything.
landing_faq4_q: Can I keep my world if I cancel?
landing_faq4_a: Yes. Download your whole world as a file anytime - even after canceling. It's your world, not ours.
landing_final_sub: Pick a name now, be playing together before your next snack.
landing_footer_disclaimer: Not affiliated with Mojang or Microsoft.
new_random_hint: We'll give your server a fun address automatically - you can share it the second it's ready.
legal_t1_b: hosting-mc rents you a small Minecraft server with your own address. We create, run, sleep, and wake the server for you. We are not affiliated with Mojang or Microsoft.
legal_t2_b: You need an account with a valid email address. You are responsible for what happens on your servers, including what your friends do on them.
legal_t3_b: Each server is a separate monthly subscription, billed by Stripe. You can cancel anytime: the server keeps running until the paid period ends, then it is suspended. Your world is kept for 7 more days and then permanently deleted. We do not offer refunds for partial months.
legal_t4_b: Do not use the service for anything illegal, for attacks on other networks, or to host content that violates the Minecraft EULA. We can suspend servers that break these rules.
legal_t5_b: We aim for high availability but do not guarantee 100% uptime. Servers sleep automatically when nobody is playing and wake on the next join attempt. Scheduled maintenance is announced in advance when possible.
legal_t6_b: Your world belongs to you. You can download it anytime. After deletion and the 7-day grace period, world data is gone forever - we cannot recover it.
legal_t7_b: The service is provided as is. To the maximum extent permitted by law, we are not liable for lost worlds, lost progress, or lost revenue. Our total liability is limited to the amount you paid in the last 3 months.
legal_t8_b: We can change these terms; material changes are announced by email. Continued use after a change means you accept it.
legal_p1_b: Account data (name, email, password hash), server data (server names, settings, world files), and billing data (handled by Stripe - we never see your card). We also store your Minecraft usernames for friends lists.
legal_p2_b: No advertising trackers, no selling data, no analytics beyond basic server logs. We do not read your in-game chat or world content.
legal_p3_b: One session cookie keeps you logged in. That is all.
legal_p4_b: Stripe (payments), Resend (transactional email), our hosting provider (servers). Each only gets the minimum data needed for its role.
legal_p5_b: Account data is kept while your account is active. Deleted servers keep their world for 7 days, then it is permanently removed. Server logs rotate and are deleted after 30 days.
legal_p6_b: You can request a copy or deletion of your data anytime by emailing us. Deleting your account removes your servers and worlds after the grace period.
legal_p7_b: Questions about these policies: support@example.com (replace with your real support address).
